# App showcase screenshots

Captured from the hosted Hypen demos on November 9, 2026 in Zen, using Responsive Design Mode at 390 × 844 CSS pixels and DPR 2. The WebP files are lossless conversions of the browser screenshots; no app content is composited or retouched.

Home Screen, MovieDB, Food, Social, Hypeflix, Calories and Files were captured through the launcher. Todo and Calculator use fresh sessions on their standalone demo URLs. The source and live links are in the root README.

To refresh: open the demo in Zen, set the same viewport and device pixel ratio, wait for the app and its images to load, and use **Take a screenshot of the viewport**. Convert the resulting PNG with `cwebp -lossless -z 9 capture.png -o <app>.webp`.
